scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter=!@jadelau/installer build && pnpm --dir packages/installer build:stage && pnpm link:cli
scripts.pack:win: pnpm --dir packages/desktop pack:win && pnpm --dir packages/installer pack
scripts.link:cli: pnpm --dir packages/cli link --global || echo '[link:cli] pnpm global directory not configured; skipping the global jiumate link (run pnpm setup once first)'
scripts.jiumate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs JIUMATE_HOME=~/.jiumate/dev-data-cli PORT=7369 -- tsx packages/cli/src/jiumate.ts
scripts.desktop: pnpm -r build && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs JIUMATE_HOME=~/.jiumate/dev-data -- pnpm --dir packages/desktop start
